make.name: Changan
make.description: State-owned Chinese carmaker based in Chongqing. Its own-brand electric cars are the Lumin city car and the Nevo (Qiyuan) range; its other EV brands, Deepal and Avatr, are listed separately.

logo.license: Public domain in the US (simple text and shapes); trademark

models.name: Lumin
models.description: Three-door electric city car on Changan's EPA0 platform, launched in China in June 2022 and later exported to Thailand and Indonesia.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Original three-door Lumin with 12.9, 17.7 or 28 kWh LFP packs.

models.name: Nevo A06
models.description: Mid-size sedan on Changan's SDA platform sold under the Nevo (Qiyuan) sub-brand, offered as a battery-electric car and as a range-extender. An earlier plug-in hybrid A06 planned for 2023 was cancelled before launch.

generations.name: Second generation (SDA)
generations.description: First production A06: new SDA platform, BEV with 51.5 or 63.2 kWh LFP packs, the larger one on 800 V.

models.name: Nevo A07
models.description: Executive sedan that launched the Nevo (Qiyuan) sub-brand in 2023, built on the EPA1 platform shared with the Deepal SL03. Sold as a BEV and as a range-extender.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: BEV with 58 or 80 kWh packs (515 or 710 km CLTC).

models.name: Nevo Q05
models.description: Compact SUV name used for two unrelated cars: a 2023 plug-in hybrid (not listed here) and, from late 2025, an all-new battery-electric SUV. The electric one is exported as the Changan UNI-E and is due in the UK as the Changan E06.

generations.name: Second generation (BEV)
generations.description: All-new battery-electric only SUV with 40.3 or 51.9 kWh LFP packs and a 120 kW front motor.

models.name: Nevo Q06
models.description: Mid-size SUV on the SDA platform launched in September 2026 with 800 V, 6C-charging battery-electric versions and a range-extender.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: BEV with 66 kWh (CALB) or 80 kWh (CATL) LFP packs, single rear motor or dual motor.

models.name: BenBen EV
models.description: Electric version of the BenBen city car. The BenBen EV (from 2015) was replaced in 2020 by the facelifted BenBen E-Star, which ended when the BenBen line was dropped in 2023.

generations.name: BenBen EV
generations.description: Original electric BenBen with a 75 hp motor and about 200 km range.

generations.name: BenBen E-Star
generations.description: Facelift with a 32.2 kWh pack (300 km NEDC).

models.name: Eado EV
models.description: Battery-electric versions of the Eado compact sedan: the first-generation Eado EV from late 2014, and EV300/EV460 versions of the second-generation car from 2018.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Eado EV with a 26 kWh pack, 120 hp and about 160 km range.

generations.name: Second generation
generations.description: EV300 and the longer-range EV460 on the second-generation Eado.

models.name: CS15 EV
models.description: Electric version of the CS15 subcompact SUV, launched in 2017 and followed by the more powerful CS15 E-Pro; the CS15 line ended in 2023.

generations.name: CS15 EV
generations.description: 75 hp motor and about 300 km of range.

models.name: Lantuozhe EV
models.description: Battery-electric version of the Lantuozhe (Hunter) mid-size pickup, unveiled at Auto Shanghai 2023.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: 130 kW Inovance motor with a CATL LFP pack.

gaps: Prices for most Changan EV trims are not set; only launch prices found in news coverage are given.
